Read more Grown at High Altitude in the Mountains of Nicaragua Our premium Single Origin Coffee comes from an exclusive, natural source deep in the mountains of Nicaragua. You'll never get a blend when you choose Lifeboost. This region in Central America is where the widest variety of Arábica beans are grown. The coffee is grown at a high altitude, which is ideal for maximizing nutrient absorption, richness, and flavor. Pure Shade Grown Coffee With No Additives All Lifeboost Coffee is Mountain Shade Grown in a Bird-Friendly Habitat. It's sun-dried, and spring water washed. You never have to worry about our coffee being exposed to chemicals, pesticides, or other harmful processes that ruin the bean's purity. It's just pure, delicious, natural coffee straight from nature. All of Our Coffee is Third Party Tested Our coffee is 3rd Party Tested for traces of heavy metals, mycotoxins, pesticides, and 400 other toxins that should not be in coffee. We're all about low acid coffee, so we also test the pH level. Most popular coffee has a pH level of 4.85 or lower (very acidic). Lifeboost's pH level is 6 or higher, which is why customers who thought they could never drink coffee again love our brand. Certified Organic Coffee by NFC - 2020 We care deeply about our customers and the environment, so that's why every bag of Lifeboost Coffee is Certified Organic by the Natural Food Certifiers (NFC) 2020, an accredited USDA National Organic Program Certifier. This ensures that our coffee farmers have not used any prohibited substances on their land like synthetic pesticides, herbicides, or fertilizers for three years before the USDA issues the Organic Seal.
